_comment: Data-driven cases for tests/account-update-billing-address.spec.js. Each key (except _comment) becomes its own Playwright test() — run one with -g "<Country>". To cover another country, add an entry; no test code changes. Addresses are REAL and intentionally DIFFERENT from the account's shipping address, so the app persists a distinct billingAddress (a billing == shipping save makes the app treat them as 'not different'). US reuses the Ghost Inspector source address (Canoga Park); CAN is a real landmark (Vancouver Convention Centre) since Ghost had no billing test. Select option values are "<code>|<name>" exactly as the live <select> exposes them; expectOptionPresent/Absent assert the billing Country->State/Province dropdown swap; zip uses that country's postal format. The form has no address-deliverability check (audit-confirmed), so these only need to be structurally valid + distinct from shipping.
